verdict.rationale: Concurrency limits are a fair question for a local inference product: RunAnywhere runs models locally through its CLI and offers an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. However, no evidence documents a maximum number of concurrent requests or connections, or the point where throughput degrades. The community benchmarks only compare single-stream tokens per second and say nothing about concurrency.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
